claim_boundary: Signal generation is offline-reproducible from FOUR frozen inputs: price cache, trade_cal receipt, PIT membership schedule AND industry metadata (basic_info). All four are required — omitting basic_info silently halves the picks, because the sector cap collapses every candidate into one 'unknown' bucket and exits 0.
Membership correctness remains a TRUSTED_HISTORICAL_ASSUMPTION, not an attested fact, and 23 of 1,895 members have no obtainable industry.
Supports only: the live 30-session drought has historical precedent.
Does NOT update the playbook, endorse the annualised return, alter the selector, or reopen the PR #16 breadth conclusion.
hash_algorithm: sha256 over file bytes; a composite is sha256 over the newline-joined 'name:sha256' pairs of its members, sorted by name
command: python scripts/backtest_1yr.py --start 2021-08-12 --end 2026-08-11 --universe-mode point_in_time --engines alpha --acceptance-mode live_equivalent --label pit5y_final --out-dir <OUT> --price-snapshot-dir <EXTRACTED>/snapshots --pit-schedule-in <BUNDLE>/pit_membership_schedule.json --calendar-in <BUNDLE>/trade_cal_receipt.json --basic-info-in <BUNDLE>/basic_info.json --dump-picks <OUT>/picks.json
clean_machine_reproduction: # or run the command above directly with TUSHARE_TOKEN unset and no network

code.identity_note: replay_code_commit is the commit whose code produced this replay. It is NOT the PR head and cannot be: committing this file advances head. Verify against the *_sha256 fields.

calendar.source: tushare trade_cal exchange=SSE is_open=1 over the run window

pit_membership_schedule.note: Membership is provider-CURRENT as-of resolution, not provider-as-of; no receipt attests to the ranking on the rebalance date. Freezing makes signal generation reproducible, which is weaker than making it correct.

basic_info.note: Industry metadata drives the per-sector cap and therefore how many picks a day yields. Omitting it made an offline replay return 322 picks against a published 641, silently and with exit 0.

snapshot_cache.note: Per-file manifest is in snapshot_manifest.json. Re-downloading from the provider will NOT reproduce these hashes byte-for-byte; only the archived cache will.

accounting_semantics.cash_constraint: allocation capped at available cash; otherwise skipped_cash
accounting_semantics.marking: daily mark-to-market on close; halted names carry last_value
accounting_semantics.exit: row exit_price at exit_date (target/stop/hold-expiry from the runner)
accounting_semantics.sharpe: mean/std of daily equity returns, annualised by sqrt(252)
accounting_semantics.drawdown: peak-to-trough on the marked-to-market equity curve
accounting_semantics.costs: NOT modelled in this simulator — returns are gross
